name: HGRN2: Gated Linear RNNs with State Expansion
notes: HGRN2 enlarges the recurrent state via an outer product with NO additional parameters and gains a linear-attention interpretation, letting it reuse GLA's chunkwise kernels. Explicitly contrasts fine-grained per-channel decays (HGRN2/GLA) with shared-per-head decays (Mamba2/xLSTM/Gated Retention): shared decays are more tensor-core-friendly but less fine-grained.
